[Source 1 — cincinnati.com (Bias: Independent / Unrated)] (URL: https://www.cincinnati.com/story/news/politics/elections/2026/11/04/who-is-annie-andrews-south-carolina-senate-winner-has-cincinnati-ties/92601894007):
Annie Andrews is the projected winner of South Carolina's U.S. Senate race.
 Andrews is the first Democrat elected to the Senate in South Carolina since 1998.
 The pediatrician earned her medical degree from the University of Cincinnati.
 She also worked as a resident doctor at Cincinnati Children's Hospital Medical Center.

Annie Andrews, the projected winner of South Carolina's U.S. Senate race, has ties to Southwest Ohio, including earning her medical degree in Cincinnati. [...] Both Decision Desk HQ and NBC called the race for Andrews, a pediatrician, less than three hours after the polls closed.

The last time South Carolina elected a Democrat to the Senate was 1998. Andrews Andrews defeated Republican incumbent Darline Graham, the sister of the late longtime Republican U.S. Sen. Lindsey Graham. [...] Andrews, a 45-year-old mother of three, earned her medical degree at the University of Cincinnati, according to her LinkedIn. She then worked as a resident physician at Cincinnati Children's Hospital Medical Center.

Andrews was born in Paducah, Kentucky, and grew up in Indianapolis. She earned her undergraduate degree at the University of Dayton where she studied pre-medicine, according to her LinkedIn.

USA Today contributed.

# Annie Andrews wins South Carolina 2026 Senate election, flipping seat for Democrats

Updated on: November 3, 2026 / 10:01 PM EST
/ CBS News

Washington — Democrat Annie Andrews defeated GOP Sen. Darline Graham in the South Carolina Senate race, CBS News projects, in a major upset. [...] Andrews, 45, is a pediatrician and campaigned on healthcare access and affordability, along with fighting corruption in Washington. She faced off against Graham, the incumbent senator who was appointed to serve out the remainder of her brother Lindsey Graham's term after his sudden death in July.
